meta: Restoring old photos with AI is fast, but sometimes grandma's or grandpa's face comes out looking like someone else.

muc.title: An old photo turns into a stranger
muc.text: AI restores old photos very quickly, but sometimes your grandparents' faces come out looking like someone else.

muc.title: Scan or photograph it well
muc.text: Scan the photo, or take a straight-on picture in even light with no glare.

muc.title: Always keep the original
muc.text: Store the paper photo safely, keep the original scan separately, and let AI edit only a copy.

muc.title: AI can invent faces
muc.text: Where the photo is blurry or torn, AI guesses and draws in features, so don't call it a real photo or use it to fool anyone.

muc.title: Check with your family
muc.text: Photograph an old picture, ask a chatbot to sharpen it, then show an older relative and ask if the faces still look right.

thu: Photograph an old picture, ask a chatbot to sharpen it, then show an older relative and ask if the faces still look right.
